$comment: JetLagged sticker sheet. JetLagged is the custom-graphics sample: its surfaces are hand-drawn Canvas charts and custom layouts rather than stock components, which is exactly the category that benefits most from rendered stickers — there is no component library to read the intended output from. Two things shape this spec. First, the summary cards, the header and the screen are annotated @Preview in place, but every parameter is defaulted and the renderer only discovers genuinely zero-argument previews — so those entries point at zero-arg wrappers in app/src/debug rather than at the main-source previews, which come back as NoSuchMethodException sidecars. Second, the chart previews are driven from the fixed-week fixtures in JetLaggedSleepFixtures.kt rather than the app's now()-based sample data, so a visual diff means something; the Screens entries are the exception, because JetLaggedHomeScreenViewModel builds its own state and offers no seam to inject one.
